title: Question on the page "searchBox"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[searchBox](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/searchBox.html)".

Hello, I am new to algolia and even with instant search.
I have a question for you, I am trying to filter out results based on the radius(35miles) around some point (latitude and longitude). I am trying to use searchBox. Can you please let me know how can I use aroundRadius and aroundLatLng with it. I have searched a lot but could not find any way to implement this. Please share your thoughts and suggestion. Thanks in advance.

comments.body: Thanks, It works. I want to ask one more thing that how can i configure aroundLatLng dynamically. I want that if user input text(address) into input field then I want to convert into lat, lng and want to configure it accordingly. Please suggest me how to configure it dynamically on every time user searches.

The logic for transforming an address into geo coordinates is done by a geo coder. Algolia provides such a solution and it's called [Algolia Places](https://community.algolia.com/places/). This solution comes with a [widget for InstantSearch.js](https://community.algolia.com/places/examples.html#instantsearchjs).

If you want to use another service, you'll have to [make your own integration with a custom widget](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/custom-widget.html).
